gpt-6.1-sol.unavailable: Use claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh for a labeled clean-context review; disclose unavailable different-family coverage. If neither preferred model is available, report the lane blocked.

score_evidence.taste: Owner prefers Opus 5.5 for UI; no numeric GPT-6.1 Sol taste rating supplied.
score_evidence.review: Owner prefers GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh for reviews; no numeric GPT-6.1 Sol audit rating supplied.

selection.fallback: Keep one owner within the preferred pair. Sol reviews fall back to a labeled clean-context Opus xhigh pass; unavailable Opus UI is blocked. A different-family agent pass still requires explicit delegation.
selection.promotion_rule: These xhigh routes are explicit owner choices, not benchmark promotions. Promote unrequested model, effort, or context changes only after the versioned ablation gate.
selection.owner_preference: Opus 5.5 xhigh is the daily driver and better for UI; GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh is preferred for reviews. These are the only catalog models.

api_only.pro_mode: Available through the API; do not imply that a local CLI session uses it.
api_only.persistence_and_ptc: Use persisted reasoning or programmatic tool calling only in an API harness that exposes them.
api_only.explicit_prompt_cache: Use only in API integrations that expose cache controls.

scoring.scale: 1-10, higher is better; null means unmeasured.
scoring.cost: Artificial Analysis cost per Intelligence Index task at the routed effort. Historical log bands: floor(10 - 9 * ln(cost / 0.03) / ln(3.91 / 0.03)), clamped to 1-10. Current xhigh costs are unmeasured; historical measurements at other efforts stay in score_evidence.
scoring.intelligence: Peak Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: round(1 + 9 * (index - 30) / (58 - 30)), clamped to 1-10; 58 is 10 and 30 is 1. Benchmark effort is not routing authorization.
scoring.speed: Median output tokens per second relative to the fastest model.
scoring.taste: Owner judgment for UI/UX, code quality, API design, and copy.
scoring.order: Shipped work weighs intelligence, then taste, then cost; cost only breaks ties.
scoring.review: Historical audit rating for Opus 5.5; GPT-6.1 Sol has no numeric audit rating. Current review routing follows the explicit owner preference, not historical rankings.
scoring.allowance: How long the $200 plan lasts before a limit hits (Claude Max 20x, ChatGPT Pro 20x). GPT-6.1 Sol allowance is unmeasured. Claude publishes no counts: the Opus 5.5 rating is owner-observed, not inferred from tokens.
